intent: Implement EventBroadcast exactly as tabled. Backpressure-aware, versioned append-only event stream port to downstream analytics. The consumer is out of process (boundary declared in the execution strategy). publish returns true when the record was accepted into the bounded stream (on_true: broadcast succeeded) and false when it was refused because the bounded buffer is full or the sink rejected it (on_false: record dropped from the broadcast only; the caller counts telemetry.pipeline.dropped stage=broadcast). stream exposes the broadcast Flux.

methods.semantics: true accepted; false refused (overflow) and counted by the caller in telemetry.pipeline.dropped{stage=broadcast}
